summary: Documents/File Manager Module - Backend: 13/13 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified working. Admin Portal → Content → Documents tab renders FileManager with Files/Storage Settings views. Team Admin → Documents tab renders FileManager with teamId for team-specific config. Storage Not Connected message shows correctly. Provider selection (Google Drive, OneDrive) with credential fields working.
critical_code_review_comments: documents.py: Clean implementation of storage config endpoints with proper validation (team_id required, provider must be google_drive or onedrive)
documents.py: _get_storage_config correctly falls back to league-level cloud_storage when team has no config
documents.py: GET /api/documents/files returns graceful empty response when no storage configured (configured: false)
FileManager.js: Well-structured component with data-testid attributes for testing, Files/Storage Settings tabs, breadcrumb navigation
FileManager.js: Team-level storage settings show provider selection with credential fields (Client ID, Secret, Refresh Token)
TeamAdminTab.js: Documents section properly renders FileManager with teamId prop for team-specific storage
test_credentials: Admin user: set via localStorage mlbl_current_user with role='admin', roles=['admin','coach']
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_docs_team_* and TEST_onedrive_team_* prefixed storage configs during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Documents/File Manager module fully tested. Backend endpoints: GET /api/documents/config (league-level), GET /api/documents/config?team_id=X (team-level), POST /api/documents/config (saves team storage provider), GET /api/documents/files (returns empty when no storage), POST /api/documents/folders (validates name + storage configured), DELETE /api/documents/files/{id} (validates storage configured). Frontend: Admin Portal → Content → Documents shows FileManager. Team Admin (team page) → Documents shows FileManager with teamId. Google Drive and OneDrive APIs require real OAuth tokens - file operations will fail gracefully without valid credentials.
